title: Product Execution Requirement
description: Experimental. One account resource a package on the product needs before it can be created. `kind` determines the binding: `event_source` via `packages[].optimization_goals[].event_sources[]`, `catalog` via `packages[].catalogs[]`, `downstream_connection` by completing the connection. Account-independent: MUST NOT carry account-specific resource IDs or names. Alternatives inside one requirement are any-of.

oneOf.title: Event source requirement
oneOf.description: Each package needs a conversion event source. Satisfied when at least one `optimization_goals[]` entry of `kind: "event"` on the package has an `event_sources[]` entry referencing an event source available to the account (registered via `sync_event_sources`, or seller-managed under `conversion_tracking.platform_managed: true`) with an `event_type` accepted here.

event_types.description: Event types that satisfy the requirement (any-of): the satisfying `event_sources[]` entry MUST use one of these `event_type` values. Omit when any event type satisfies it.

oneOf.title: Catalog requirement
oneOf.description: Each package needs a catalog. Satisfied by a `packages[].catalogs[]` entry whose `type` is in `catalog_types`. App promotion uses `["app"]`; app items carry `app_id`, `bundle_id`, `apple_id`, and `store_url`. Every listed type MUST also appear in the product's `catalog_types`.

catalog_types.description: Catalog types that satisfy the requirement (any-of). One catalog of any listed type satisfies it.

oneOf.title: Downstream connection requirement
oneOf.description: The product needs a seller-side platform connection or grant, such as the advertiser account or the publisher identity the ads run as. Satisfied by completing the connection, not by a request field; a missing, pending, expired, or revoked connection fails with `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED` per `error-details/authorization-required.json`. Because a declared list is complete, a seller that would reject for a missing connection, including the advertiser account, MUST declare it. With several eligible connected identities, the seller applies its documented default.

connection.description: The required connection. Because the declaration is account-independent, `status` is omitted or `unknown` and `resource_ref` MUST be omitted.
